PACE CHANGED 25 Jul. 5:44/km was too slow — disproved by the 20 Jul lap data (ran 5:41/5:34/5:36 unprompted, negative split, HR peaked 170 vs LTHR 174, self-logged RPE 4, all during a deload). New target 5:30/km. Running OUTDOORS this week, so no treadmill speed — HR governs, pace follows.

HOW TO RUN IT: reps should FINISH at HR 168-172, hard cap 175. Start rep 1 at 5:30/km and read the HR. If rep 1 finishes at 165 and feels like RPE 6, take reps 3-4 toward 5:25. If it finishes above 175, back off to 5:35. The pace target is a starting guess, not the instruction — the HR is the instruction.

LOG THESE: pace each rep landed at, avg power each rep, and whether rep 4 held rep 1's pace or drifted. That's what sets the real threshold number. Flattest route available — not the one with the climb at the end. Reps by distance (1.6 km), 90s standing recovery. Finish by 19:30 for the 20:00 cutoff.
Run, not the bike, this week. After 8 hours seated the Wattbike is more hip flexion and spinal loading — upright and moving is the better stimulus on an office week. HR ≤148 on the Garmin.

2026-08-02.title: Easy run — 30 min (long run moved to Sat 1 Aug)

blocks.text: CHANGED: this was a 55-min long run. The long run moved to Saturday 1 Aug to clear Monday's TT slot. Keep this genuinely easy — HR under 148. Tomorrow's time trial sets the threshold anchor for the whole block and it only works on fresh legs.

THE POINT: this pins LTHR and LT pace properly. Avg HR from minutes 10-30 = LTHR. Avg pace across the 30 ≈ LT pace. Everything downstream in this block inherits these numbers, so a compromised TT is worse than no TT. No hills this week — they start w/c 10 Aug precisely so this stays clean.

BEFORE YOU GO: reset Stryd cal factor 101.7 → 100.0. Comparability with July sessions matters less than a clean anchor. Post-session, compare Garmin distance vs Stryd app distance as the confirmation check. Chest strap on. Same 1km flat straight as 20 Jul — five turnarounds, not the 250m loop.
SCREEN SETUP: HR, 3-second power, elapsed time. HIDE INSTANT PACE. You will chase it otherwise and the first two minutes decide whether the other 28 are any good.

PACING: cap 250W for the first two minutes — cardiac lag is real, the 20 Jul file showed HR at 147 thirty seconds into rep 2 against a 165 steady state, taking ~150s to arrive. First km no faster than 5:40. Then HR-governed: 158-164 to min 5, 164-169 to min 10, 169-173 to min 20, 172-176 to min 27, empty the tank the last three minutes.
EXPECTED: 5.2-5.5 km, power 245W+. If you finish and could have gone harder, log that honestly — it changes how we read the number.

prerun.text: PRE-RUN — ~9 min, in order. Spine-neutral throughout: no standing toe touches, no seated forward folds, no supine knees-to-chest. Press START on the first step, it auto-advances the whole routine.

prerun.label: Knee-to-wall dorsiflexion
prerun.detail: 10 reps/side, 2s hold at end range. Heel down, knee over 2nd toe. Switch at halfway. Note the L/R gap difference.

prerun.label: Ankle circles
prerun.detail: 20 each direction, both sides. Slow, full range.

prerun.label: Bent-knee heel raise
prerun.detail: 15 reps, 2s lower. Soleus — takes the running load, don't skip it.

prerun.label: Single-leg balance hold
prerun.detail: 20s on the weaker ankle only. Eyes open.

prerun.label: Half-kneeling hip flexor
prerun.detail: 30s/side. Squeeze the down-leg glute, tuck the pelvis. Do NOT arch the back to feel it.

prerun.label: 90/90 hip switches
prerun.detail: 8 slow reps. Sit tall, hands behind, chest up. Stop short if the low back rounds to get there.

prerun.label: Leg swings (wall support)
prerun.detail: 12 front/back then 12 lateral per side. Small range first 4, then build. Swing from the hip, trunk braced.

prerun.label: Glute bridge
prerun.detail: 15 reps, 2s squeeze at top, ribs down.

prerun.label: Banded lateral walk
prerun.detail: 10 steps each direction x2. Band above knees, soft knees, no torso lean.

prerun.label: Pogo hops
prerun.detail: 2 x 15. Stiff ankles, minimal knee bend, short ground contact. SKIP on easy days or if flat.
